supported.guidance: Install each specialist Skill into ~/.claude/skills. The managed executor reads only the effective Claude Code connection record and uses its matching credential privately for fixed Pure Tokens API requests.
Install each specialist Skill into ~/.agents/skills. The managed executor uses Codex's verified effective Pure Tokens connection adapter for fixed API requests.
Install each specialist Skill into ~/.workbuddy/skills. The managed executor reads only the unambiguous matching WorkBuddy model connection credential privately for fixed Pure Tokens API requests.

Install each specialist Skill into ~/.gemini/skills. The managed executor reads only the effective Gemini CLI connection record and uses its matching credential privately for fixed Pure Tokens API requests.
Install each specialist Skill into ~/.grok/skills. The managed executor reads only the active Grok Build model connection credential privately for fixed Pure Tokens API requests.
Install each specialist Skill into ~/.config/opencode/skills. The managed executor reads only the active OpenCode provider connection credential privately for fixed Pure Tokens API requests.
Install each specialist Skill into ~/.trae/skills. The managed executor is installed with the Skills; the Trae credential adapter is not yet verified, so it stops before a request.
